prompt: Give me an explanation on how a website was developed
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: 1) Explain how a website was developed (1:Pass,2:Partial,3:Fail,4:Partial); 2) Provide a clear development process rather than a narrow subtopic (1:Pass,2:Partial,3:Fail,4:Partial); 3) Cover the overall lifecycle (1:Pass,2:Partial,3:Fail,4:Partial). Candidate 1 offers the most complete end-to-end website development walkthrough (planning/design/build/QA/launch/maintenance). Candidate 4 covers many similar phases but is framed mainly as a developer’s responsibilities around launch, Candidate 2 is largely limited to UI/design, and Candidate 3 focuses on front-end vs back-end differences instead of the overall development process.
